SEARCH
Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.webbrowser

Class UrlNormalizer

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.webbrowser.UrlNormalizer
public final class UrlNormalizer extends Object
The smart address bar's resolution logic, isolated from any UI so it can be unit-tested headless.

Given the raw text typed into the location field, normalize(java.lang.String, org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.webbrowser.SearchEngine) decides whether it is a URL or a search query and returns an absolute URL the WebEngine can load:

  • text that already carries a scheme (https://, file:, about:blank, ...) is used verbatim (after a syntax check);
  • text that looks like a host (example.com, localhost:8080, an IP, or a single label with a path) becomes an https:// URL;
  • anything else (contains spaces, or is a bare word) is handed to the configured SearchEngine.

The heuristics intentionally favour "search" for ambiguous single tokens so the common case of typing a search phrase works, while a dotted host or an explicit scheme always navigates.
